description: Inline README previews made from the user-supplied synchronized terminal and RViz2 recordings. These are edited recorded evidence, not a new runtime validation.

timeline.edit: A hard cut skips the interval between the two excerpts. Terminal and RViz2 retain matching source timestamps within each excerpt.

verification: Decoded GIF frames inspected for readable terminal queries/replies and synchronized RViz2 target changes. Crops focus on the demonstrated interaction; startup banner and local paths are excluded.

query-and-result-preview.gif.description: Actual recorded terminal query and replies stacked above synchronized RViz2 results. Shows smartphone identification, phone tracking request and subsequent switch from person mask to phone mask.

query-and-result-poster.png.description: Final GIF frame showing the smartphone answer, phone tracking confirmation and (for combined layout) phone mask.

terminal-preview.gif.description: Larger terminal-only view of the same two actual-speed interaction excerpts.

terminal-poster.png.description: Final GIF frame showing the smartphone answer, phone tracking confirmation and (for combined layout) phone mask.
